Neha + team —

Quick notes after an initial pass on the Helix ask and their checklist:

- Audit rights: Legal prefers to avoid unlimited on-site audit language. Recommended compromise: allow for a cooperative third-party audit or mutually agreed-upon third-party assessment limited to systems processing Helix data. We can provide SOC 2 + pen-test reports and allow a scoped review under NDA.
- Subprocessors: provide the current list (attached). For critical subprocessors we can add a clause to notify customers 30 days before onboard and provide mitigation options.
- Cross-border/data transfer: we support region pinning for hosted instances. For their US-only requirement we should propose a US-region tenancy with SCCs for backups where applicable and provide the Data Transfer Addendum option.
- DocuSign: once DPA redline is agreed we can route to DocuSign. Prefer to include an Appendix listing evidence available (SOC2, pen-test, incident response summary) rather than a blanket audit clause.

Karthik — please confirm whether the cooperative-audit wording below is acceptable. I'll prepare a DPA redline: 'Customer may request a limited, documented compliance review subject to mutual scope, confidentiality and reasonable notice.'

Marissa Cole
Head of Customer Security Programs, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
